review.message: apply_discount only discounts totals strictly greater than 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of at least 100 (>= 100).
paginate returns size + 1 items because the slice end is start + size + 1, violating the rule to return at most size items.
apply_discount uses `total > 100`, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100. A total of exactly 100 incorrectly receives no discount.
parse_age is missing from the module; the rules require parse_age(text) to raise ValueError for negative ages.
paginate returns `items[start:start + size + 1]`, which can yield up to size + 1 items, violating the rule to return AT MOST `size` items.
parse_age is missing from the module; every module must implement parse_age(text) which raises ValueError for negative ages.
paginate returns up to size + 1 items, violating the rule that it returns AT MOST `size` items.
apply_discount only discounts totals strictly greater than 100, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100 (i.e. total >= 100).
parse_age does not raise ValueError for negative ages as required.
paginate returns `size + 1` items (`items[start:start + size + 1]`), violating the rule that it returns AT MOST `size` items for the given page.
apply_discount uses `total > 100`, so a total of exactly 100 receives no discount, but the rule requires 10% off for totals of AT LEAST 100 (`>= 100`).
parse_age does not reject negative ages; `parse_age("-5")` returns -5 instead of raising ValueError as required.

The PR states every module must follow the paginate/apply_discount/parse_age rules, but 12 of the 15 modules (including module_01) define none of these functions. Confirm whether those functions are intentionally omitted or need to be added to each module.
paginate returns up to size+1 items, violating the rule to return AT MOST size items for the given page.
apply_discount only applies 10% off for totals strictly greater than 100, but the rule requires it for totals of AT LEAST 100.
parse_age does not raise ValueError for negative ages as required.
paginate returns items[start:start + size + 1], which can yield size + 1 items, violating the rule that it returns AT MOST `size` items for the given page.
apply_discount uses `if total > 100`, so a total of exactly 100 does not receive the 10% discount, violating the rule that the discount applies to totals of AT LEAST 100.
parse_age converts text with int(text) and returns it without validating, so negative ages are accepted instead of raising ValueError as required.
